skill.name: avalonia-layout-zafiro
skill.description: Guides Avalonia UI layout with Zafiro.Avalonia using shared styles, semantic containers, icon resources, behaviors, and reusable components.
skill.summary: Build maintainable Avalonia XAML layouts with Zafiro.Avalonia patterns for themes, containers, icons, behaviors, and components.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: No confirmed security issues were found in the reviewed locations. The static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, Avalonia XML examples, and an XML namespace URI.

static_findings.snippet: To keep XAML clean and maintainable, minimize logic in views and avoid excessive use of converters.

Avoid deep nesting. Deeply nested XAML is hard to read and can impact performance.
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui">
| `themes.md` | Theme organization and shared styles | Setting up or refining app themes |
| `containers.md` | Semantic containers (`HeaderedContainer`, `EdgePanel`, `Card`) | Structuring vie
| `icons.md` | Icon usage with `IconExtension` and `IconOptions` | Adding and customizing icons |
| `behaviors.md` | `Xaml.Interaction.Behaviors` and avoiding Converters | Implementing complex inter
| `components.md` | Generic components and avoiding nesting | Creating reusable UI elements |
`/mnt/fast/Repos/angor/src/Angor/Avalonia/Angor.Avalonia.sln`
- [ ] **Used semantic containers?** (e.g., `HeaderedContainer` instead of `Border` with manual heade
- [ ] **Avoided redundant properties?** Use shared styles in `axaml` files.
- [ ] **Minimized nesting?** Flatten layouts using `EdgePanel` or generic components.
- [ ] **Icons via extension?** Use `{Icon fa-name}` and `IconOptions` for styling.
- [ ] **Behaviors over code-behind?** Use `Interaction.Behaviors` for UI-logic.
- Create deep nesting of `Grid` and `StackPanel`.
- Use `IValueConverter` for simple logic that belongs in the ViewModel.
- Use `DynamicResource` for colors and brushes.
- Leverage `Zafiro.Avalonia` specific panels like `EdgePanel` for common UI patterns.

content.value_statement: Avalonia views can become difficult to maintain when layout logic, styling, and icon usage are repeated across files. This skill guides cleaner Zafiro.Avalonia layouts with shared styles, semantic containers, reusable components, and focused interaction patterns.
actual_capabilities: Maps layout questions to the relevant guidance file before deeper review.
Explains shared theme structure for colors, brushes, styles, and app themes.
Recommends Zafiro.Avalonia containers such as HeaderedContainer, EdgePanel, and Card.
Shows icon usage through IconExtension, IconOptions, and shared icon resources.
Guides behavior-based UI interactions and converter avoidance.
Highlights XAML anti-patterns such as deep nesting, hardcoded values, and repeated properties.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run or validate Avalonia builds.
It assumes the project uses Avalonia and Zafiro.Avalonia controls.
It is not a complete API reference for Avalonia or Zafiro.Avalonia.
It may need project-specific review for custom styles, controls, and accessibility rules.

use_cases.title: Refactor a Dense View
use_cases.description: Convert repeated Grid, Border, and StackPanel patterns into semantic containers and reusable components.

use_cases.title: Organize Theme Resources
use_cases.description: Plan Colors.axaml, style files, merged dictionaries, and DynamicResource usage for a consistent theme.

use_cases.title: Review Interaction Patterns
use_cases.description: Move simple visual logic from converters or code-behind into ViewModel properties, bindings, or behaviors.

prompt_templates.title: Review One View
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Avalonia view. Find repeated layout, hardcoded values, and deep nesting. Suggest cleaner Zafiro.Avalonia patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Shared Styles
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a theme structure for this Avalonia app. Group colors, brushes, containers, typography, and icons into maintainable files.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Containers and Icons
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this screen concept. Use HeaderedContainer, EdgePanel, Card, IconExtension, and IconOptions where they improve clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Design a UI Pattern System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable layout strategy for this module. Define component boundaries, style classes, behavior usage, and review checks.

output_examples.input: A dashboard repeats bordered sections with headers, icons, and hardcoded colors.
output: Move shared colors and brushes into theme resources.
Use EdgePanel for label, icon, and action rows.
Replace repeated icon styling with IconOptions.

output_examples.input: A form uses several converters for visual state and focus behavior.
output: Keep reusable visual conversions only when they are simple and broadly useful.
Move data formatting into ViewModel properties when possible.
Use behaviors for focus, animation, and event-specific UI logic.

output_examples.input: A list item uses nested grids for a title, status, and action button.
output: Flatten the item with EdgePanel or a small reusable component.
Move repeated spacing and typography into style classes.
Use a shared icon resource for repeated status indicators.

best_practices: Read only the guidance files that match the current layout task.
Move repeated visual properties into shared axaml styles.
Use semantic containers and small components to keep parent views clear.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode repeated colors, sizes, or borders in views.
Do not add nested Grid and StackPanel structures for simple rows.
Do not use converters for logic that belongs in the ViewModel.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps improve Avalonia XAML layout using Zafiro.Avalonia style and component patterns.

faq.question: Does it generate complete Avalonia applications?
faq.answer: No. It provides layout guidance, review criteria, and refactoring suggestions.

faq.question: Can it help with themes?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains shared colors, brushes, style files, merged dictionaries, and DynamicResource usage.

faq.question: Does it require Zafiro.Avalonia?
faq.answer: The guidance is most useful when Zafiro.Avalonia controls and extensions are available.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it replace UI testing?
faq.answer: No. You still need build checks, visual review, accessibility review, and product validation.
